transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Over the last month I’ve just lost interest in my art, dancing, and even my job, and I can’t seem to care about anything the way I used to. It just feels like everything has gone completely flat, and I don't know how to get back to myself.
Have you ever had another period in your life, lasting at least two weeks, when you felt this same loss of interest or depression before this past month? If so, how many times has it happened?

Actually, looking back, this current low period has been going on steadily for about five months now, ever since that intense tax rush ended. I haven't ever had another period of depression or loss of interest like this before this current stretch started.

During this period, have you become unable to manage basic daily activities like getting out of bed, showering, or eating, or have you had any hallucinations or strongly false beliefs? Or are you still able to function somewhat despite feeling down?

I'm still functioning, but it's a massive struggle; basic chores like showering are exhausting, dishes are piling up, and I have to force myself to eat. I'm still going to work, but I've been making mistakes and was even pulled into meetings about my accuracy. I haven't had any hallucinations or strange beliefs, though.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living or thoughts of hurting or killing yourself? If yes, have you made any plans or taken any steps toward it?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or ending my life. Even though I feel really down and exhausted, I've never thought about doing anything like that.

During these five months, have you also had changes in your sleep, appetite or weight, energy, concentration, or felt slowed down or unusually guilty or worthless? If so, which of these have been happening most days?

Yes, almost all of those have been happening daily. I toss and turn all night, have to force myself to eat, and feel completely exhausted and physically slowed down, like I'm moving underwater. My concentration is shot so I keep making mistakes at work, which just makes me feel incredibly guilty and useless.
